title: Error contract boundary
request: Compare the two technically viable error contract approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared correct or preferred. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly final-error-a or final-error-b and whose final_choice is exactly resumable_problems or typed_statuses. Do not use tools.

evidence.content: Evidence E-38: resumable problem documents carry machine-readable recovery options and let clients continue from context-specific checkpoints. They support richer future remediation, although clients must validate a more flexible response structure. Choice id: resumable_problems.

Evidence E-12: typed status responses enumerate known failures with stable fields and tested client branches. They keep compatibility and monitoring straightforward, although adding a new recovery path requires another coordinated contract revision. Choice id: typed_statuses.
